title: Minimum dimension for a real Bapat--Sunder F_A counterexample
formal_target: Find n <= 15, a rational real Gram matrix A = X^T X, and rational x with x^T F_A x > per(A) x^T x, or prove a nontrivial infinite-family theorem or a rigorous finite-dimensional exclusion.
literature_correction: The cited order-16 examples are either real counterexamples to stronger POT/Oppenheim statements or complex Hermitian F_A real-Rayleigh counterexamples; the primary sources do not provide a real symmetric order-16 F_A counterexample.
current_route: terminal partial result: the complete real rank-at-most-two cones at orders four through eight are proved and independently audited; the general Bezoutian reduction remains exact, but the natural wedge ansatz and the final order-nine exactification diagnostic did not close an all-orders factorization; the unrestricted real problem remains open and this route is paused pending a genuinely new invariant
pdf_policy: Create exactly one final PDF only after exact arithmetic and independent audit pass.
